title: Better Than Vanilla
description: Enhance your Minecraft experience with richer sounds, improved biomes, and more immersive details.
body:
Welcome to Better Than Vanilla, the perfect modpack for making your experience, well, better than vanilla!
**This modpack includes:**

- **Optimization** (Sodium, Lithium, etc.)
- **QoL** (Xaero's MiniMap, Xaero's WorldMap, Zoomify, etc.)
- **Sounds** (Sound Physics Remastered, Sounds, etc.)
- **Biomes** (Biomes o' Plenty, etc.)
- **Terrain** (Terralith, Geophilic, etc.)
- **Structures** (Dungeons and Taverns, Explorify, etc.)
  
**and more coming soon!**
